task: Develop a composite risk index combining tropical cyclone regime shifts and sea level rise, and apply it globally to evaluate mangrove risk by end of century.
named_inputs: IPCC AR6 relative sea level rise rates for SSP245/370/585
Historical tropical cyclone tracks from MIT downscaled MPI-ESM1-2-HR
Country boundary and mangrove area reference layer
primary_outputs: explicit TC and SLR component layers
method_commitments: derive mangrove spatial units from provided point sample
extract sea-level-rise rates for mangrove locations using median 2100 rates
derive a transparent historical TC regime-pressure proxy emphasizing major/intense storms
construct explicit composite risk index with reproducible normalization and equal weighting
report scenario-specific outputs, validation references, and limitations
validation_references: RSLR thresholds of 4 and 7 mm/yr from related work for interpretive benchmarking
Comparison of scenario risk distributions and component distributions
